hook: Your feet can stand on snow that is really salt.
title: Your Gujarat snow is really salt
description: The Great Rann of Kutch in Gujarat is a huge white salt desert that looks like snow. In the monsoon it fills with water and becomes a shallow lake. Then the salt comes back. Part of the Places That Shouldn't Exist series.
comment_prompt: Would you visit? Yes or no
